request.query: infimum of weighted support polynomial derivative determinant index bound

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.pderiv
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {φ : MvPolynomial σ R}
  [inst_1 : AddCancelCommMonoid M] {w : σ → M} {n n' : M} {i : σ},
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w φ n →
    n' + w i = n → MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w ((MvPolynomial.pderiv i) φ) n'

items.name: Finset.inf_le_centerMass
AddMonoidAlgebra.le_inf_support_finset_prod
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_6} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T]
  [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T]
  {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A), ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).support.inf degt ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).support.inf degt
